_readme: Master profile for Tailor. Achievements are stored as parts, not finished sentences, so the app can recombine them for each job description. Syntax is documented in tailor/README.md. Sources: the portfolio's work and projects data (corrected Sept 2026) and the resume PDF; anything only in the PDF is marked verify:true. The two claims you retracted (Sahara refunds, organisation-wide Skillchain adoption) are deliberately absent.
